subject: Turning customer needs into a practical design
hook: I don't really know what I want yet. Is that a problem?
fb:
"I don't really know what I want yet. Is it too early to contact you?"

Honestly, that's how most of our projects begin. People come to us with a problem, not a finished design: the bedroom with nowhere to put clothes, the living room where the TV cables are everywhere, the kitchen that never has enough drawer space.

Bring what you've got: a list of what annoys you, a rough idea of what you need to store and a few photos you like. At the free, no-obligation consultation we'll talk it through, measure up and turn it into a design you can look at before deciding anything.

Got a question? Pop it in the comments.

I don't know exactly what I want yet. Is it too early to get in touch?

Not at all. Most SUPERIO projects start with a problem rather than a finished design: not enough wardrobe space, cables everywhere, a kitchen short on drawers.

Bring a list of what isn't working, a rough idea of what you need to store and a few photos you like. At your free, no-obligation design consultation, we'll talk through options, measure the room and turn your ideas into a design you can review before you decide anything. You'll then get an itemised quote with no hidden costs.

Everything is made in our own workshop in Hanley, Stoke-on-Trent, and installed by our own team. Tap Learn more to get in touch.
